preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Every character in the input string s is a lowercase English letter.
The length of the input string s is between 1 and 200 (inclusive).
The integer n is between 1 and 10^9 (inclusive).
s is a string and n is an integer.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer modulo 10007, representing the number of distinct palindromes obtainable by inserting exactly n lowercase letters into s.

postconditions.expression: all(len(p) == len(s) + n for p in [p for p in palindromes if len(p) == len(s) + n])
postconditions.description: Every counted palindrome p has exactly n additional characters inserted into s, so its length is |s| + n.

postconditions.expression: all(p == p[::-1] for p in palindromes)
postconditions.description: Every counted palindrome p reads the same forwards and backwards.

postconditions.expression: all(any(p[i] == s[j] for j in range(len(s)) if i - j <= n and i - j >= -n) for p in palindromes for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Every character in s appears in the same relative order in the palindrome p, with exactly n additional characters inserted (no deletions or reordering of original characters).
The output is the count of distinct palindromes modulo 10007, where palindromes are all possible strings formed by inserting exactly n lowercase letters into s.
